data.summary: Reviews are overwhelmingly authentic with high customer satisfaction. The primary red flag is the duplication of 5-star reviews across two Google profiles, suggesting possible review copying or platform manipulation. However, the detailed content, specific complaints, and varied writing styles strongly indicate a base of genuine, happy customers. The company demonstrates an ability to resolve issues when they arise.
fake_signals: Identical 5-star review text posted on both Google profiles (Local and HQ)

negative_evidence: Initial complaint indicates a lack of follow-through on a paid extra ($1800) after the salesman left
positive_evidence: The 3-star review was resolved by Josalyn who 'handled the issues' and 'kept the communication going until everything was completed'

authentic_signals: Specific employee names (Jason, Donavan, Ruben, DJ, Sergio, Joe, Josalyn)
Detailed project timelines (14 days, 7 days, 10 days, less than a month)
Mention of specific locations (Melissa, East Texas)
Varied writing styles and personal anecdotes
Constructive 3-star review with specific complaint and resolution
complaint_patterns: Lack of follow-up on paid extras
data.discrepancy_explanation: Only Google reviews are available, showing a consistent 4.7 rating. No other platforms have ratings to compare.

reviews.text: Wonderful and quick experience! We have had many different types of pools in the past and have stuck with Fiberglass as our ultimate favorite. When looking for a Fiberglass company most of them didn't come near to the service and speed of AquaPools. Donavan and Ruben came to see our property and gathered everything we wanted for our pool and even answered all of our concerns. This was by far the best experience we have had and YES, OUR POOL WAS FINISHED IN 14 DAYS! The project team was on top of everything and every move. It even rained a little and though that would push it back some, but it did not. Thankfully it dried in time for the work to continue without a hitch. We ordered the Ovation 26 in Santorini Sky and we added the electric pool heater to continue to enjoy the pool into the winter. We were also surprised by the cost as it was WAY lower than our previous pools and we got a great deal. If we ever have to do this again we will definitely have AquaPools do it for us! Thanks for the great service and the care you continue to take towards our purchase.
reviews.author: Alia Garces

reviews.text:
UPDATE:
Josalyn came in and saved the day. She handled the issues and kept the communication going until everything was completed. I was always happy with the pool just felt the lack of communication did the company and myself a disservice. I truly appreciate her and the team handling my issues and now we are ready to enjoy our pool!!

I love my pool but the service has been horrible. The sales man is no longer with the company and no one seems to know anything. I paid out of pocket $1800 for a backwash?!? Something the city required and I still haven’t got that done been waiting over 2 months for answers and keep getting the run around. Everything started off great but the service end is sad!!!
reviews.author: Indria Potts

reviews.text: Jason with aqua pools came out to give us insight on how the whole process would work of getting a fiber glass in ground pool installed. He was great at communicating and answering any questions we had From there everything landed in place so quickly , from start to finish we were so impressed with how quick and how professional each contractor was! The install was so fast and easy, the pool cleaning and class was very simple and we are more than grateful to be enjoying our pool all summer long! I would recommend to everyone looking to get a pool!
reviews.author: Victoria Barron

reviews.text:
We were incredibly impressed with Jason and the entire Aquapools team, crews, and the process! The pool and concrete look incredible and we are just so thankful for everyone along the way, making this a stress-free and enjoyable experience!

Each team that worked on our pool showed great attention to detail and it shows! They take pride in their work and were eager to make it perfect.

Thank you!
reviews.author: Jessica Pickard

reviews.text: Aqua Pool has built 2 pools for me. Our first experience with them was in 2021 where we built our pool in Melissa, north of Dallas and again this past month where they built a pool for us at our new house in East Texas. The reason I went with them the first time was the pricing and time to complete the project. Both times we went from dig to swim in less than a month. Both pools were installed beautifully we didn’t have a bad thing to say from the actual pool to the concrete. We first built with Sergio and then DJ and both had been so meticulous through the process and heard and addressed any concerns we had with placement and sloping. Communication had been great throughout the whole project from the builder to the back office. Lastly I want to thank our sales rep Jason for sticking with me while I debated for a few months if we would be able to pull off our pool build. He got me various quotes, specs and answered any questions we had about the various pool styles out there. A different Sergio came out to clean our pool and left us ready to jump in. So happy with our new pool and with our experience with the Aqua Pool crew.
reviews.author: Ramelyn Dumdumaya

reviews.text: Aquamarine Pools of DFW installed our pool in February, and although it’s still too cold to get in, we couldn’t be happier with the install. DJ and his crew were amazing. They were very patient with all my questions and made sure I was happy with the location before they started digging. The concrete crew and electricians were great as well, and Sergio was very helpful when explaining how everything works with the pump/filter. From start to finish, it only took a total of seven days, and that was with temps in the teens, and feels like temps in the single digits. The office kept us informed on everything that would be happening, and our salesperson, Jason, was always available to answer any questions we had. We are so proud of our new pool and can’t wait for summer to get here!!
reviews.author: Leigh Anne Goldsmith

reviews.text: This was probably one of my easiest 5 Star reviews that I've done. First off this was our first pool and I must say that Aquamarine Pools was AMAZING and an even better experience. Jason Milholen was our sales representative and he was very thorough and knowledgeable about the pools that Aquamarine sold. He laid everything thing out for us that we wanted. A few days later they were scheduling our dig date. The Crew that did our pool were also very professional and had our pool dug and dropped in one day. The entire process took about 4 - 5 days to complete. If anyone is looking for a Fiberglass pool don't look any farther than Aquarium Pools of Dallas you will not be disappointed.
reviews.author: Joey Foster

reviews.text: We had our pool installed this June 2024.  The customer service from Jason Milholen was amazing.  He helped us decide which pool was best for us and continued to take my phone calls throughout the installation phase even though my project was turned over to coordinator. As with any project of this size there were bumps in the road such as weather delays, etc but we are extremely satisfied with the end project.
reviews.author: Betty Sauer

reviews.text: Highly recommend Aquamarine Pools. Donnovan was amazing to work with and got us our dream pool! The install team was amazing and FAST. We were able to swim within a couple of weeks. Any concerns or questions we had were answered immediately and taken care of. We are first time pool owners and couldn’t have asked for a better experience. We made sure to shop around and were impressed with the pricing and just overall process of Aquamarine. We have heard horror stories from other companies and that is not what we received. Reach out to Aquamarine Pools. Can’t wait to swim this summer!
reviews.author: Brittney Moore

reviews.text: We had the best experience! From beginning to end, our pool was installed in just 10 days! Turned out beautiful and loved the support we received from AquaPools from consultation to finish. Money well spent and so cost efficient compared to other companies!
reviews.author: Stephanie Vigil

reviews.text: After extensive research, I chose Aquamarine Pools and worked with Joe. The entire experience was flawless from beginning to end. I was especially impressed by how quickly the installation was completed—it only took a few days. The work was excellent and clean, with great attention to every detail. Thank you!
reviews.author: Mustafa Başaran

reviews.text:
Great customer service. We had a few hiccups along the process but the company went above and beyond!

When exploring to do a fiberglass insert pool things to consider are;

30 year warranty vs the look and feel of having concrete.

The only downside I can think of with a fiberglass insert so far is not having a bottom floor drain. The only circulator in a fiberglass insert is the skimmer.

With a traditional pool you have a floor drain that pulls the sand and debris  off the bottom. With a fiberglass insert we have a little robot guy that is picking the debris up in place of the floor drain.

You have to decide if the savings of a fiberglass insert pool is worth having a few little things to adjust. For us, it was worth it.

The upgraded hot tub heater is a must in our opinion. Worth it.

There is also the initial price of the pool but there should be budget set aside for little extras that you may not consider at first. Such as extra concrete, cleaning supplies (automatic robot), and repair of any landscaping.

The only thing I would have changed would have lowered the pool a little more so we didn’t have to put a linear drain in-between the back porch and pool concrete. We have about it a .5” drop from the pool to the back porch. It was hard to determine the grade but they did their very best and the pool sloping towards the linear drain keeps water out of the pool and off the back porch.

Very pleased with the look of the pool. It looks high quality and professional. Every crew was courteous and professional.
reviews.author: Denver Hines

reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience with Aquamarine Pools of DFW.  Donna in sales is amazing, she was knowledgeable and not pushy. She came out to our property to see the best location for the pool and discussed logistics and timeline.  Communication between all the members of the staff was excellent and they kept me informed and updated through the entire pool installation process.  My entire family loves our beautiful pool.
reviews.author: Jayne McNally

reviews.text:
We are loving our pool!!
Smooth process start to finish.
*Jason our salesman has done an excellent job keeping in touch with us throughout the process.
*Scotty has been so professional and did a fantastic job teaching me how to take care of the pool. He went above and beyond!
*The installation guys were kind, professional and right on time.
We had a lot of rain soon after the pool was installed and hadn’t had time for concrete yet, the installers and Scotty returned asap to see about the pool.
I definitely recommend this company!
reviews.author: Crystal Dunn

reviews.text:
We have been working with Aqua pools for our new pool purchase and build! They have been knowledgeable, consistent and overall good people to work with. A special shout out to Mike who worked with us over several months while we went back and forth on different styles and models - he was very flexible with us throughout it all. We have also worked with Amber on scheduling and paperwork - she has been really great and has answered all our questions.  We are excited to continue our build in the coming weeks!

EDIT: We are 90% complete with our pool build with Aqua Pools DFW and overall have been enjoying our backyard oasis! Thank you so much to all that helped make it happen!

They addressed any concerns and questions appropriately which is very appreciated. All in all, we’d use them again though and will recommend them as they were good to work with all around!
reviews.author: Ana Fitzpatrick

reviews.text: I’ve wanted a pool for many years. After much research I decided to go with a fiberglass pool.  Aquamarine Pools has the best reputation in fiberglass pool installation in our area. One of my coworkers also mentioned he had a fiberglass pool installed by Aquamarine Pools and had nothing but good things to say. I was sold! I signed my contract in February and my chosen pool (we went with the Aviva Chic model) was ready for delivery in May. Keep lead time in mind for your planning purposes! Once the pool is ready for delivery everything moves very fast. The hole was dug and the pool was placed in one day. From the time the install team dug the hole to the time the concrete team poured the concrete was about two weeks. It probably would have been even faster if it wasn’t for the rain. The whole team was wonderful to work with. My sales rep, Gabe, was amazing. Jr. and DJ with the install team were awesome and made the install look so easy. Amazing to watch how they maneuvered that pool into our backyard! The concrete and electrical teams did excellent work. Sergio made sure the pool was cleaned up and sparkling once construction was complete and patiently stepped me through equipment operation. And Jocelyne helped keep things moving. She was always very helpful and responsive with any inquiries I had. Overall it was a great experience and we are very happy with our new pool. Done just in time for summer!
reviews.author: Angela Butler

reviews.text:
For those looking to install a new pool, consider a fiberglass pool.  Gunite pools require a lot of maintenance and can be quite costly over the long term, while a fiberglass pool requires such little maintenance and is highly cost effective.

Aquamarine Pools were straight up with the costs.  Showing me cost and time requirements.  No hidden fees or gimmicks!  The cost of the installation of my pool was the quoted price.  There were no surprises!  The options for your pool are almost limitless.  Feel confident when dealing with Donavan, or any of the Aquamarine Pools of DFW staff.

The initial construction/installation took less than 3 day!  Very professional and mindful of exact digging and safety of installation.  The construction was well planed as I had my pool installed close to my house, but all construction done was carefully considered even before the digging began.  Top notch professionalism to the construction crew!

The cement decking done was simply outstanding!  Completed in 1 day!  Well constructed and the spray deck simply looks fantastic!  From the first day dig, to the completion of the cement deck was less than 1 week!

I have had my pool for over 3 years now (almost 4 years) and the quality and craftsmanship of the construction and the quality of the pool has been fantastic.  No issues or problems with the pool itself or the install!  See my pictures as the initial construction, to the completed landscape around the pool!  I think this turned out so well that I had to take a lot of time to write this review.  It is worth every penny!  If you decide to get a fiberglass pool from Aquamarine Pools of DFW, know that you get a great pool for the price and a great install!
reviews.author: Jay Edgar

reviews.text:
I researched a lot of pool companies before deciding on Aqua Marine in Alvarado.
Asked to be contacted online about a quote and was contacted by Jason right away.
He came out we talked and looked at our backyard.
After discussing options found what we liked.
From that initial meeting it went great. From start to finish was never a problem.
Always was kept informed of next step.
If I could give 10 stars I would.
Thanks to all involved.
